definitions.gloss: external; outward; pertaining to outward appearance
definitions.explanation: Relating to the outward appearance or external look of something, as opposed to its internal substance, function, or character. Used when discussing how something appears on the surface.

examples.japanese: {外観的|がいかんてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧なさそうだ。
examples.english: It seems to have no problems in terms of outward appearance.

examples.japanese: {外観的|がいかんてき}な{美|うつく}しさ⟦だけでなく→〜だけでなく：18373_dakedenaku⟧、⟦{機能性|きのうせい}→機能性：25513_kinousei⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Not just external beauty, but functionality is also important.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{外観的|がいかんてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ほとんど→ほとんど：00847_hotondo⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{内部|ないぶ}→内部：05583_naibu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{構造|こうぞう}→構造：02730_kouzou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧。
examples.english: These two products look almost the same on the outside, but their internal structures differ greatly.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{外観|がいかん}→外観：12154_gaikan⟧ (outward appearance, exterior) and the suffix ～⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ (pertaining to, -like). Used in both everyday and technical contexts to distinguish surface-level characteristics from deeper qualities.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {外観的|がいかんてき}な⟦{特徴|とくちょう}→特徴：03456_tokuchou⟧: outward characteristics
- {外観的|がいかんてき}な⟦{変化|へんか}→変化：03615_henka⟧: change in outward appearance
- {外観的|がいかんてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}する→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧: to judge by outward appearance

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{表面的|ひょうめんてき}→表面的：18749_hyoumenteki⟧: superficial — emphasizes surface-level quality, often with a negative nuance of being shallow
- ⟦{見|み}た{目|め}→見た目：14110_mitame⟧: appearance, looks — a more colloquial way to refer to how something looks
- ⟦{内面的|ないめんてき}→内面的：05679_naimenteki⟧: internal, inner — the opposite, referring to inner qualities or character
